listing.name: Out of Place Characters
listing.summary: It replaces all the character portraits in the game with celebrities. Yes, you will be one of those celebrities, so choose wisely!
listing.aiSummary: Replaces all character portraits with images of real-world celebrities.

description:
Nota Bene: I legally do not take credit for any of the portraits as I did not give birth to any of these people! This is made in the spirit of good humor and should not be taken as a super serious mod. I certainly had a lot of fun making these.

Download here:

Spoiler
Q&A!

What does this do?
It replaces all the character portraits in the game with celebrities. Yes, you will be one of those celebrities, so choose wisely!

They don't all look so super great!
Well, what can you do, I worked with what I had available. Some have lower resolution than others and obviously the background colors really make them pop out since trying to crop them out would have been a nightmare. This mod is more oriented to just have a laugh or two with some fun character portraits!

The dialog of the character specifies a different gender than the portrait!
Yeah, that can happen as some characters had helmets on and had no specific gender to go on and then there is also the RNG of the game that does some voodoo magic to select the portraits randomly. I am not a coder, so these little mishaps will happen, though in a variety of rare cases. But if anyone has a good fix for this and can contribute to this mod, I am an open book with sharp spikes and boiling lava!

I don't recognize some of these people!
Neither did I, since.. fun fact: I didn't realize that the average person only likes and keeps up with information for a maximum of 80 or so celebrities out there. I had to scrap the bottom of the barrel really hard to double that number to meet the portrait quota of the game. In other words I was begging the search engine to find me some extra celebrities even if they were less known! So here we are.. story of my life!

Can I change one of the portraits if I don't like it?
Hahahahahaha, NO.. but Yes.. I have a nice trick for you to do that: All you need to do is go into the mods/opc/graphics/portraits folder and find the one you want to exterminate and replace and use the following tutorial on how to create your new Portrait. The Portrait Specifications: keep the same name, make sure you save as .PNG, and make sure the size is 128x128px.

What if I want to add extra portraits for myself?
You can use my other mod (along side of this one) called: Play as YourselfTutorial:

aiDescription: Replaces all character portraits with images of real-world celebrities. The portraits vary in resolution and background color, and some may not match the character's gender due to game mechanics. Users can manually replace specific portraits by editing files in the mod's folder.
